title: Typing an inactive number in full on a part sale or vendor bill line shows the inactive message
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I1 is inactive here. At Staging Heavy Duty: a received vendor bill (Delivery) with at least one line (note the part on that line), and an open part sale (note its lines and total).
custom_steps:
1. Open the received vendor bill (Delivery) and edit one of its lines to change the part it points to.
  2. In the part field type "QAPL-I1" in full.
  3. Try to save the line, then close and reopen the vendor bill.
  4. Open the part sale and click Add Part.
  5. In the part field type "qapl-i1" (lower case) in full.
  6. Fill Description and Qty 1, then click Save.
  7. Close the dialog and reload the part sale.
custom_expected:
1. The line's part field is editable.
  2. The dropdown shows only "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."; QAPL-I1 is not offered and there is no special-order or "Create ... as a new part" option.
  3. The line cannot be saved with QAPL-I1; after reopening, the line still points to its original part.
  4. The Part dialog opens.
  5. The dropdown shows only "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the stocked number QAPL-I1 (not the typed "qapl-i1"); no special-order or "Create ... as a new part" option.
  6. The part field turns red with "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."; no line is added.
  7. The part sale has no QAPL-I1 line; its lines and total are unchanged.
